newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso weakens, sets new record low.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso weakens, sets new record low.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended a seesaw session that saw it gain sharply against the dollar in early trade, but end 1.95 pesos lower at a new historic low of 1,094.45, interbank dealers said.
They said the peso rose to an intraday high of 1,086.45 early in the session on a wave of dollar sales, including $40 million dropped on the market from the telecommunications sector.
But subsequent corporate demand for U.S. currency conspired to put strong downward pressure on the peso later in the day.
Dealers reported 344 trades for a total of $171 million and said the peso closed just off its intraday low of 1,094.50.
